cat:
# /etc/systemd/system/picar-local-vlm.service
[Unit]
Description=vision-picar local VLM (3.80.B: Qwen2.5-VL-3B VE under TensorRT Edge-LLM, :8005)
After=network-online.target
# A driver that keeps dying (an OOM kill each time it loads) is left
# stopped after three restarts in 15 min: the VLM is then absent and the
# cloud tier answers, rather than a 4 GB load spike every 30 s. The burst
# counts every start, the first one too: 4 = the start + 3 restarts.
StartLimitIntervalSec=900
# 3.108: a bench holds the VLM off for its run with this flag (cleared at
# every boot): tools/jetson/vlm_hold.sh.
ConditionPathExists=!/run/picar-vlm-hold
StartLimitBurst=4

[Service]
User=picar
WorkingDirectory=/home/picar/vision-picar-service
# LOCAL_VLM_ENGINES, LOCAL_VLM_EDGELLM and APP_SHARED_SECRET.
EnvironmentFile=/home/picar/.vision-picar-local-vlm.env
ExecStart=/home/picar/vision-picar-service/.venv/bin/python -m service.local_vlm.server
# The first process the kernel kills when memory runs out (3.80, the user's
# floor of 2026-10-14): losing the VLM sends identity to the cloud tier;
# losing the robot server stops the robot.
OOMScoreAdjust=1000
# A kernel OOM kill of the driver must not stop the unit by itself: the
# service sees its driver gone, exits 3, and Restart= decides.
OOMPolicy=continue
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=30
TimeoutStopSec=20
# SIGTERM to the service only; it closes the driver's stdin itself, so a
# stop is never mistaken for a driver death. The rest is killed after.
KillMode=mixed
StandardOutput=append:/home/picar/.vision-picar-local-vlm.log
StandardError=append:/home/picar/.vision-picar-local-vlm.log

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
